MgO ProductsQ-Rock™ SheathingTechnical resources

01 / HOW IT WORKS

Two layers.
One integrated panel.

01 / ACOUSTIC FIBER

Absorb sound.

A lightweight layer made from 100% recycled fibers supports acoustic absorption.

  • Antimicrobial protection
  • Moisture and vapor resistance
  • Low-VOC material
02 / MAGNESIUM OXIDE

Add resilience.

Dense MgO sheathing adds strength and a durable surface.

  • Structural and non-structural options
  • Impact resistance
  • Resistance to water, insects and mold

From walls to floors.

04 / ASSEMBLY PERFORMANCE

Consider the
complete system.

Acoustic and fire performance depend on the tested assembly, including finishes, insulation, supporting construction and installation.

Match the test to your project.

Published product information lists 30-, 60- and 120-minute configurations. Confirm the applicable test report and assembly details with GBS; panel thickness alone does not establish a fire rating.
